_comment: Pinned sources/versions for reproducible builds. Large binaries are never committed to git - fetch/build scripts in image-build/ use these to rebuild deterministically. Update this file whenever a pinned version changes.

rvvm._comment: RVVM has no stable release channel the maintainer recommends using (v0.6 is explicitly marked superseded) - pin a specific nightly CI artifact by commit, not a tag. This is the portable baseline build, shipped at tools/rvvm_x86_64.exe in the payload - always included, always works regardless of host CPU.

rvvmFast._comment: Round 4 (docs/phase4-spike-results.md): same RVVM source, same commit as 'rvvm' above - only the compiler flags differ, so this is a clean optimization-only variant, not a code fork. Self-built (not a nightly CI artifact) via mingw-w64 cross-compile from WSL: `make CC=x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc CFLAGS="-mavx -mavx2 -mfma -maes -msse4.2" USE_LOCK_DEBUG=0`. Deliberately does NOT target BMI1/BMI2 (no -march= preset used) - a real target machine's CPU-Z report showed BMI1/BMI2 masked by its hypervisor despite the underlying silicon supporting it; using a named -march=haswell/broadwell preset would have baked those in and crashed on that machine. Shipped at tools/fast/rvvm_x86_64.exe + tools/fast/librvvm.dll, auto-selected at runtime by launcher/cpufeatures.go (fastRVVMSupported: AVX2+FMA3+AES) instead of the portable baseline above - never distributed as a separate download, so it can never be run on an incompatible CPU. Measured one-shot A/B (boot to login prompt, same hardware): wall time effectively unchanged (41.34s vs 41.53s), CPU time ~3% lower (51.09s vs 49.67s) - a modest, real improvement, not a dramatic one.

firmware._comment: OpenSBI + U-Boot combined firmware, used as RVVM's M-mode positional firmware argument. Enables the standard extlinux boot path (see docs/phase0-spike-results.md) rather than RVVM's bare -k direct-kernel path.

guestOS._comment: First Debian release with official riscv64 support. Built via image-build/build-rootfs.sh (cross-arch debootstrap, not booting a VM).

kernel._comment: Custom-built, NOT the stock Debian linux-image-riscv64 package - see docs/phase1-spike-results.md and docs/phase2-spike-results.md for why (missing CONFIG_DRM_SIMPLEDRM/CONFIG_SYSFB_SIMPLEFB breaks the guest display; missing CONFIG_I2C_HID_OF means RVVM's HID-over-I2C keyboard/mouse never binds). Version matches Debian's shipped kernel exactly; config is Debian's own config with display+input drivers force-enabled, several security-hardening options (AUDIT/IMA/EVM/APPARMOR/FTRACE/KPROBES) disabled, and several irrelevant driver trees trimmed. Built by image-build/build-kernel.sh.
kernel.configSeededFrom: Debian's linux-image-riscv64 package config for the same version
